label: sparse early-position token-combination feature (n/o prefix at t=3-4; early copy steps of short sequences)
explanation: Very sparse (0.024% of steps). Never fires at t<3. About 59% of mass is in the original phase at t=3-4, usually right after inputs n/o (e.g. p o n [x]); the rest is delimiter/copy steps, concentrated at recall_idx 2 of short sequences (L=3-4), with first token p/x/m and output often f. Each component depends on specific token combinations, and no simple predicate reaches good precision: the best predicate (t=3-4 right after two n/o inputs) has dev F1 0.11 and mass recall 0.21. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.118, max 0.213) and is not clearly modulated by any tested variable. Never fires when copying has gone wrong (correct=0).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=3 & prev_tok=o (+4.75), phase=2 & in_tok=s (+4.28), orig0=p (+4.24), prev_tok=n (+4.12), phase=2 & out_tok=f (+3.70), prev2_tok=n (+3.30). Lower it: L=4 & recall_idx=-1 (-3.14), in_tok=1 (-2.89), orig1=w (-2.19), phase=2 (-2.10).
